explication: Meshery is a self-service cloud-native platform for designing and managing Kubernetes infrastructure and applications across clusters and clouds. The principal workflow is an engineer using the UI to configure a design, validate or dry-run it, and manage deployment through the server and infrastructure integrations. Major documented branches include curated design templates, multi-cluster lifecycle management, observability, and extensible integrations; the CLI is another user entry point. The README establishes product capabilities, while sampled source mainly supports the UI-to-server proxy; unsampled implementation details limit confidence in internal wiring.
